title: Passives and absolute clauses
description: Lexical passives as rows (held up → 強盗に遭う, cleared up → 晴れる with the weather it dropped) and the absolute clause NP V-ed , S (NPをVて、S).

cases.sentence: the bank was held up last night .
cases.expect: 銀行は昨夜強盗に遭った。

cases.sentence: his work finished , he went to bed .
cases.expect: 彼の仕事を終えて、彼は寝た。
